vulnerability.name: USN-5454-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5454-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in CUPS. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Joshua Mason discovered that CUPS incorrectly handled the secret key used  to access the administrative web interface. A remote attacker could  possibly use this issue to open a session as an administrator and execute  arbitrary code. (CVE-2022-26691)   It was discovered that CUPS incorrectly handled certain memory operations  when handling IPP printing. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause CUPS to crash, leading to a denial of service, or obtain sensitive  information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04  LTS.  (CVE-2019-8842, CVE-2020-10001)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in CUPS. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
